Fictionalco Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results

TESTVILLE, May 5, 2026 -- Fictionalco Group, a made-up company used only in tests, today announced results for the first quarter fiscal 2026.

Revenue was $8.0 billion for the quarter, compared with $7.5 billion in the prior-year quarter.

Outlook: for fiscal 2026, Fictionalco expects diluted earnings-per-share to grow approximately 1.5% from $14.23 in fiscal 2025.
